answer: Let payouts follow how much each identity adds that no other identity already provides. At every close, answers and grades are grouped by similarity, and one reward is split across each group instead of paid to every member in full. An honest agent with its own voice keeps its whole share. A farm of near-identical keys lands in one group and splits a single share, so adding keys drives its per-key pay toward the nadir. Originality is the anchor, and even a whisper of copied structure is enough to group them.
